title: Descent of arbitrary compatible internal module morphisms on splitting charts
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, $p:U\to X$ a finite etale morphism of schemes, and $Q,P$ internal $\Lambda_X$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], with the inverse-image functors and composition comparisons of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] and [def-sfb-module-upper-star-comp]. A splitting chart is a weakly etale $g:Y\to X$, an integer $n\ge0$, and maps $t_j:Y\to U$ indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(n)$ with $t_jp=g$ such that the induced maps $Y\to U\times_XY$ form a coproduct decomposition. Suppose for every splitting chart $c$ a morphism $d_c:g^*Q\to g^*P$ is given. Assume compatibility in the following explicit sense: for any two charts $c_1,c_2$ and weakly etale maps $a:Z\to Y_1$, $b:Z\to Y_2$ with $ag_1=bg_2$, the maps $a^*d_{c_1}$ and $b^*d_{c_2}$ are equal after conjugation by the specified inverse-image composition comparisons and the equality $ag_1=bg_2$. Then there is $f:Q\to P$ with $g^*f=d_c$ for every chart. For that $f$, if every $d_c$ is epic, then $f$ is epic. No surjectivity hypothesis on $p$, freeness hypothesis on $Q,P$, or coefficient characteristic assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Apply finiteEtaleSplitHom_exists to the compatible chart maps. This gives one internal module morphism with all prescribed inverse images.
For this morphism, finiteEtaleSplitHom_epi gives the epimorphism conclusion whenever all prescribed chart maps are epic.

theorem finiteEtaleSplitHom_descent
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite p] [Etale p]
    (Q P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (d : ∀ c : FiniteEtaleModuleChart p,
      (upperStar Λ c.map).obj Q ⟶ (upperStar Λ c.map).obj P)
    (hd : FiniteEtaleModuleChart.Compatible Λ Q P d) :
    ∃ f : Q ⟶ P, (∀ c, (upperStar Λ c.map).map f = d c) ∧
      ((∀ c, Epi (d c)) → Epi f)
